steps.summary: Signed in to Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ as admin@bench.local and opened Posts → Published. The live DOM shows exactly three rows, all with status "Published" (no pagination, no additional rows), of which all three titles begin with "Seed:": "Seed: Welcome to the bench", "Seed: Release notes for September", and "Seed: House style guide".

Created the post "fwgh5-n2 Bench Post" in Ghost admin with body text "This bench post was created under runid fwgh5-n2." (runid once), saved it, then in Post settings chose the existing tag "Bench News" from the suggestions (not "Bench Newsletter"), set the excerpt to "Bench post created under runid fwgh5-n2." (runid once) and the publish date to 2026-09-01 12:00 UTC, closed settings, and completed the publish flow (Publish → Continue, final review → Publish post, right now). The post now appears in the Published list with status "Published" ("By Bench Admin in Bench News - 01 Sep 2026"); all settings values were re-read from the reopened settings panel on the published post.
